Welcome to the Internet
(Collaboration with Little Big)
Russia Documentary
Notes: In 2021, Oliver confirmed via social media that he had recorded a documentary showcasing his activities in Russia (Link), stating it was about "the creative process and my journey integrating into Russia as a foreigner." The documentary has yet to release, though a clip of it was uploaded to his TikTok before being deleted soon afterwards (Link), and another was recently played at Oliver's Alone in a Crowd tour (Link).

Name: 🏆 Alone In A Crowd [Movie]
Notes: Full length movie made by Oliver for the Alone In A Crowd world tour. Features each Oliver character so far, Cornelius Cumming's lore, and many other visuals. Oliver has never stated whether or not it was ever going to be released online, but after the tour in many interviews, they would ask about the movie and he would always quickly deflect the question with another answer, giving off the vibe he didn't know himself or he hadn't planned on it releasing in the future.

Name: Oliver Tree & Little Ricky: Cowboy & Alien Tears
Notes: Sequel to the comic released in 2021, illustrated by Orpheus Collar. Was mentioned in one of the last pages of the orignal comic, meaning the idea has likely been around since then. Orpheus has posted WIP sketches of this to his Instagram on several occasions and confirmed that he had started drawing it off of "handshake agreements & vibes" but then ultimately said he was waiting on a contract with advance pay, which then he would actually start the main work.
